description: 13.09 HIDDEN counts ranged attacks made 'during this turn or during the previous turn', and FIRE OVERWATCH (15.08) is snap shooting (15.09: 'shoots as described in Making Attacks') at the end of the OPPONENT's Movement phase, so its 13.09 shot record carries the opponent's turn. A unit that overwatched in the enemy's last turn is therefore NOT Hidden in its own turn, but IS Hidden in the enemy's next turn if it holds fire now. The AI's F002 hold-fire price used to read only 'Hidden now', priced that unit at 0 and shot its next-turn Hidden away for a chip shot. Board: ai_hidden_awareness_11e's (Player 1's Shield-Captain in the dense terrain area at (260,750), the Ork Battlewagon 10 inches away as its only target), set to battle round 2, with the shot record the engine's FIRE OVERWATCH writes in Player 2's battle-round-1 turn (HiddenShotRecord.stamp_diffs at play-order index 3 — the writer MovementPhase._snap_finish calls; tests/unit/test_ai_hidden_predictions_11e.gd drives the real window path). Asserts: (a) the ENGINE says not Hidden now and Hidden at index 5 (TerrainManager.is_model_hidden_at); (b) F002 prices the forfeit above 0; (c) the PLAYER PATH: a real click on 'Suggest (K)' writes the AI's reasoning into the game log — it holds fire 'to be Hidden in the enemy's next turn' — and the K breakdown's hold-fire record carries 'Cost of losing Hidden' with the corrected glossary tooltip; (d) CONTROLS: the same unit with a shot record from THIS turn shoots (nothing left to sell), and the shipped defaults (profile cleared) shoot. Loads tests/bench_profiles/yt_findings_on.json: the Hidden weights ship OFF.

steps.script: GameEventLog.has_ai_entry_containing_any(["holds fire to be Hidden in the enemy's next turn"])
